verdict.rationale: LlamaParse's own docs describe Parse as layout-aware OCR that turns scans and images into clean text, and claim accuracy on scanned pages and handwriting beyond generic OCR. However, the evidence never addresses the story's hard cases, and there is no independent hands-on check of scan accuracy. missing for 10: documented handling of skewed/rotated pages, stamps, low-quality or photographed scans, and independent or hands-on corroboration of OCR accuracy on scanned inputs.

support.subject: As a developer, scanned and photographed documents OCR accurately — skewed pages, stamps, low quality scans included

citations.quote: layout-aware OCR that turns PDFs, scans, tables, and charts into clean markdown, text, or JSON
it reads tables, charts, scanned pages, and 130+ file types with layout-aware accuracy that generic OCR and PDF-to-text tools can’t match
Turn PDFs, scans, or images into clean LLM-ready text
Turn even the most complex layouts, tables, charts, handwriting, checkboxes, and images into clean markdown
